definition: An entity composed of people and resources structured to achieve specific goals, including research, industrial, academic, or governmental activities.
A geographical place or area where an entity, event, or activity is situated or occurs.
A challenge, objective, or goal that requires a solution, execution, or improvement.
A digital application, platform, or programming resource used to perform computational or analytical tasks.
A structured approach, procedure, or computational logic used to solve a problem or perform a task.
A quantitative measure used to evaluate performance, efficiency, quality, or risk.
An inherent or measurable characteristic of an entity, material, or system.
A temporary and organized effort involving multiple actors aimed at achieving specific objectives or solving a problem.
A set of interconnected components working together to perform a specific function or achieve a goal.
A physical device or equipment used in industrial, computational, or experimental processes.
A substance or matter used in the production or manufacturing of products.
A finished or semi-finished item resulting from a manufacturing or production process.
A sequence of actions or operations performed to transform inputs into outputs.
An individual or a defined function performed by a person within an organization or system.
An occurrence or incident that happens at a specific time and may affect systems, processes, or entities.
A set of rules, regulations, or guidelines governing actions and decisions within an organization or system.
An abstract idea or notion representing principles, theories, or general understandings.
Structured or unstructured information collected, processed, or used for analysis and decision-making.
An asset or input required for processes, including energy, time, or human effort.
